newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ticks lower, nearby spread active.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ticks lower, nearby spread active.

text.p: London white sugar futures turned lower in solid Monday activity which was dominated by pre-expiry dealings in the nearby March/May spread.

The afternoon trading pattern was broadly similar to the morning with buying of the spread by one leading trade house countered by broker selling, which combined to push the value out to $3.30 at one point.
"It hasn't really changed (from the morning). London is weak...but it's reasonably steady," said one trader.
London followed the weakness on the New York market but selling of the spot whites premium at just above $70 kept March/March within its recent range.
At 1645 GMT March was down $1.00 at $303.60 and May down $1.20 at $300.60. All other positions lost ground.
Overall volume amounted to 2,098 lots, boosted by against actuals and spread trades. One large trade house cross was also seen on the March contract.
Fresh physical news was thin on the ground, although traders said they expected Iran to re-enter the market this week to buy 14,000 tonnes of whites for April after cancelling a tender last week.
The Paris market was also weaker. March, which goes off the board on Friday, stood down 30 cents at $304.00 and May was $1.40 lower at $300.40.
